announcements.headline: Notification on PDMR transactions
announcements.insight: Director dealings are routine governance updates. They do not alter the strategic trajectory established by the recent acquisition agreement and capital raising activities.

announcements.headline: Announcement of the envisaged issuance of notes
announcements.insight: NLB announces notes issuance following a prior subordinated note filing in October. This capital action supports the bank's balance sheet.

announcements.headline: NLB publishes Financial Calendar for 2027
announcements.insight: NLB publishes its Financial Calendar for 2027. This follows the Q3 results in November and sets expectations for future disclosures.

announcements.headline: 3rd Quarter Results
announcements.insight: Following the August SREP requirement, this Q3 report details financial performance. The September acquisition agreement suggests strategic expansion despite regulatory capital pressures.

announcements.headline: Announcement of the issuance of subordinated notes
announcements.insight: The issuance of subordinated notes follows the SREP requirement announcement in August. This capital raise supports the recently agreed acquisition of more than 55% in DBS.

announcements.headline: Agreement to Acquire More Than 55% in DBS reached
announcements.insight: NLB has reached an agreement to acquire a controlling stake in DBS. This follows the July threshold confirmation and August SREP requirement, indicating progress in the Addiko transaction.

announcements.headline: NLB d.d., Ljubljana announces new SREP requirement
announcements.insight: NLB d.d. announces a new SREP requirement following its half-year financial report in August. This regulatory update may influence future capital decisions or strategic planning.

announcements.headline: Notification on PDMR transactions
announcements.insight: Director dealings are reported. This follows the amended offering memorandum in July and half-year results in August.

announcements.headline: Half-year Financial Report
announcements.insight: NLB publishes its half-year financial report. This follows recent corporate actions including an amended offering memorandum for Addiko Bank AG.

announcements.headline: NLB Publishes Amended Offering Memorandum - Addiko
announcements.insight: The amended offering memorandum follows the extended acceptance period confirmed in July. Shareholders should monitor for further developments regarding the Addiko transaction.

announcements.headline: Confirmed Threshold and Extended Acceptance Period
announcements.insight: Following the June 16 ATA announcement, this filing confirms threshold details and extends the acceptance period for the ongoing offer process.

announcements.headline: Press Release / Announcement pursuant to Sec 5 ATA
announcements.insight: This announcement follows the June 11 improvement of the VTO for Addiko Bank AG. Shareholders should monitor subsequent filings for details on the restructuring process.

announcements.headline: AGM Statement
announcements.insight: The AGM Statement follows the June VTO improvement for Addiko Bank AG. Shareholders should monitor governance outcomes from this meeting.

announcements.headline: Improvement of the VTO for Addiko Bank AG
announcements.insight: NLB announces an improvement of the VTO for Addiko Bank AG. This follows a June 2026 press release and director shareholding update.

announcements.headline: Director/PDMR Shareholding
announcements.insight: Director dealings are reported. This follows a June 2026 announcement pursuant to Sec 5 ATA.

announcements.headline: Press Release / Announcement pursuant to Sec 5 ATA
announcements.insight: This is an administrative press release pursuant to Sec 5 ATA. It provides no specific details on financial impact or strategic direction for shareholders.
